scientific_question: Hold the original V4.4 stimulus panel, models, decoding, split, numerical kernels, estimands, controls, and reporting hierarchy fixed while changing only the structured enumeration grammar (explicit index versus invariant bullet).

representation.preprocessing: StandardScaler plus whitened PCA fitted inside every grouped discovery fold; held-out transforms are fitted on discovery only.
representation.layer_selection: maximize mean discovery grouped-CV logistic and nearest-centroid balanced accuracy; tie-break by NCC, logistic, then earlier within-cell layer
representation.confirmation_policy: evaluate every layer on held-out confirmation, but never use confirmation values for site or layer selection
representation.independent_layer_selection: select separately within every model-by-grammar cell; never force layer-number matching across architectures or grammars

causal_population_policy.cellwise_native_replication: resolved strict-format cohort with frozen discovery choices and disjoint held-out confirmation
causal_population_policy.cross_grammar_claim: permitted only when the exact original source identities are common; otherwise report the two cellwise replications without a direct grammar-effect estimand
causal_population_policy.replacement_role: replacement preserves fixed cellwise quota but does not create source identity for a cross-grammar contrast
causal_population_policy.negative_results: retain and report; never replace a row because of an effect estimate or claim gate

forbidden_primary_paths: generic classification/regression over every captured token site
correct-only versus all-sample duplication for every report frame
layer or cohort reselection using confirmation outcomes
cross-grammar causal claims on source-mismatched replacement rows
